title: Design, synthesis, anti-inflammatory evaluation, and molecular modelling of new coumarin-based analogs combined curcumin and other heterocycles as potential TNF-alpha production inhibitors via upregulating Nrf2/HO-1, downregulating AKT/mTOR signalling pathways and downregulating NF-kappaB in LPS induced macrophages.
authors: Ghany, Lina M A Abdel; Beshay, Botros Y; Youssef Moustafa, Amal M; Maghrabi, Ali Hassan Ahmed; Ali, Eman Hussain Khalifa; Saleem, Rasha Mohammed; Zaki, Islam; Ryad, Noha
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文为香豆素类抗炎化合物的合成与活性评价，分子建模仅涉及小分子与TNF-alpha蛋白的对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Persistent inflammation contributes to various inflammatory conditions. Inflammation-related diseases may be treated by inhibiting pro-inflammatory mediators and cytokines. Curcumin and coumarin derivatives can target signalling pathways and cellular factors to address immune-related and inflammatory ailments. This study involved designing and synthesising three series of coumarin-based analogs that incorporated curcumin and other heterocycles. These analogs were evaluated for their potential as anti-inflammatory agents in LPS-induced macrophages. Among the fourteen synthesised coumarin derivatives, compound 14b, which contained 3,4-dimethoxybenzylidene hydrazinyl, demonstrated the highest anti-inflammatory activity with an EC(50) value of 5.32 muM. The anti-inflammatory effects of 14b were achieved by modulating signalling pathways like AKT/mTOR and Nrf2/HO-1, and downregulating NF-kbeta, resulting in reduced production of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha. The modelling studies revealed that 14b and dexamethasone bind to the same TNF-alpha pocket, suggesting that 14b has potential as a therapeutic agent superior to dexamethasone for TNF-alpha.
abstract_zh: 持续性炎症与多种炎症性疾病相关。通过抑制促炎介质和细胞因子，可能治疗炎症相关疾病。姜黄素和香豆素衍生物能够靶向信号通路和细胞因子，以应对免疫相关及炎症性疾病。本研究设计并合成了三个系列的香豆素类类似物，这些类似物结合了姜黄素及其他杂环结构。在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的巨噬细胞中，评估了这些类似物作为抗炎剂的潜力。在合成的十四个香豆素衍生物中，含有3,4-二甲氧基亚苄基肼基的化合物14b表现出最高的抗炎活性，其EC(50)值为5.32 μM。14b的抗炎作用通过调节AKT/mTOR和Nrf2/HO-1等信号通路，并下调NF-κB，从而减少IL-6、IL-1β和TNF-α等促炎细胞因子的产生来实现。建模研究表明，14b和地塞米松结合于TNF-α的同一口袋，提示14b作为治疗剂在针对TNF-α方面可能优于地塞米松。
